rows.label: P2 · round three, writer c · one fix by me
rows.article: The love can go first, though
guide: The younger state can look at the grown-up life
rows.note: Three rounds. Round one's list of evidence lost the cold readers. Round one's a2 and round two's a (with my fix) were both 100% AI, and both went: the quoted lines, then why the answer works, then trust taking its time. Round three's brief named that order. My fix: "your record with them" became "your track record" (the cold read tripped on "with them"). The parenthetical calls back "Calling yourself an idiot… Your little one was listening". Its 47 words are under Pangram's 50, so it can't be checked alone; with the h2 and P1, 100% Human (118).

rows.label: P3 · your story, as the guide tells it
rows.article: I was about five when my mom
rows.note: Nothing added. "Mom" is the word you use in your own writing, and the aside is in parentheses now. Is this your memory? The guide's "I" is an AI draft of your ideas, so I asked before putting it in your voice. It's 34 words; the section with it, 100% Human (154).

rows.label: P4 · writer a · one fix by me
rows.note: Both grounding runs flagged "It went against the feeling of the moment" as a change of meaning. Your "emotional logic of the moment" is what the hate implied, not the feeling itself, and she didn't tell you you weren't angry. That wording came from my brief, and the writers copied it. Fixed: "Fights don't usually go like that." "She didn't tell me I wasn't angry" moved to the end, and the cold reads said it leads into the next paragraph. 100% Human alone (66); the section, 100% Human (220).

rows.label: P5 · writer a · one guide sentence cut
rows.article: When it's your little one yelling at you

guide.quote: Don’t turn the sentence into a formula. “But I love you” can become dismissive when it means, “Therefore stop being angry.” The useful test is whether the love can remain alive, hear the anger, and take whatever is true in it seriously.
guide.from: guide paragraph 5, all but its last sentence

rows.note: Cut: "Non-retaliation is one expression of love; it is not a colder substitute for love." Not Every Hero P2 already has "you hear it out instead of snapping back… Love needs both". 100% Human alone (71); the section, 100% Human (291).
